description: This Java source file defines a validator class for the 'Field' model in the OpenMRS project. It is responsible for validating instances of the 'Field' class, ensuring required properties are present and correctly formatted.

classes.name: FieldValidator
classes.description: A class that implements Spring's Validator interface to validate 'Field' objects according to specified rules, such as non-null 'name', 'selectMultiple', and 'retired' fields, as well as field length validations.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports validation of a given class type, specifically if it is assignable from the 'Field' class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a given object, ensuring required properties are set and conform to length constraints, recording errors as appropriate.
